failure_rules: Any correctness, freshness, migration, corruption, timeout, or nonzero-exit failure rejects the candidate.

Any whole-tree or whole-node-table amplification on repeated stable-publication bounded reads, or any full, unchanged, narrow, expanded-guidance, or rebuild absolute-transfer or database-adjusted-efficiency threshold breach rejects the candidate.

Any hot-query plan scan, temporary sort, missing owning index, unbounded retained materialization, worker or thread oversubscription, unexplained busy/lock failure, excessive publication writer-unavailable interval, or surviving canceled process rejects the candidate.

Any cross-root identity leak, same-root double publication, partial canceled generation, failed reopen, nonzero final WAL/stage state, or unexpected SQLite operating-profile drift rejects the candidate.
A threshold miss is reported and investigated; results are not silently excluded or thresholds changed after measurement.
